name: Fighter Antitheurge
body:
Where some train for glory in battle, to grow strength of arms and reach of reputation the antitheurge trains to combat spellcasters and monsters that partake in such tricks. Antitheurges forgo the heaviest armors and shields and train the mind to defend the body. In doing so, they learn that all beings have some magic within. By tapping into that power they learn to overwhelm the magic of others. The antitheurge is a foe no mage wishes to meet across the battlefield.

Mind Over Metal (Ex)

The antitheurge trains to protect the mind and body as one without relying on steel alone. They gain 4 + Int skill points per level and have good Will saves.

This ability replaces heavy armor proficiency and tower shield proficiency.

Proper Form (Ex)

Antitheurges train to use their natural strengths in one area to overcome weakness in another, they may use either their Strength or Dexterity score when selecting feats with a minimum requirement in either score.When substituting in this way treat all text of the feat as referring to the chosen ability. For example an antitheurge with only 10 Dexterity but 13 Strength could select Combat Reflexes and they would use their Strength modifier to determine the number of additional attacks of opportunity provided by that feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat normally gained at 1st level.

Spell Shield (Su)

At 2nd level, the antitheurge gains spell shield as the spelljack ability of the same name. This ability begins at +1 and increases by an additional +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd.

This ability replaces bravery and its improvements.

Detect Magic (Sp)

At 3rd level the antitheurge gains the ability to cast detect magic at will as a spell-like ability.

This ability replaces the armor training ability normally gained at 3rd level.

Barrier Breaker (Su)

At 6th level, the antitheurge has cultivated a better understanding of magical protection spells and items and learned how to thwart them. As a standard action the antitheurge may make a single attack at their highest base attack bonus. If the target of this attack is benefiting from a bonus to AC provided by a spell, spell-like ability, or magic item that bonus to AC does not apply against this attack and the antitheurge gains a bonus on the damage roll equal to the highest AC bonus ignored.

This ability replaces the bonus feat normally gained at 6th level.

Shatterspell (Su)

At 8th level, the antitheurge can break even more magical effects through force of will and weapon. The antitheurge gains Shatterspell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

This ability replaces the bonus feat normally gained at 8th level.

Arcane Sight (Sp)

At 11th level, the antitheurge may cast arcane sight at will as a spell-like ability rather than detect magic.

This ability replaces the armor training normally gained at 11th level.

Reave Magic (Su)

At 16th level, the antitheurge’s nature manifests in vicious wounds to those who cast magic. Whenever the antitheurge confirms a critical hit against a creature with a spellcasting feature or spell-like abilities that creature must make a Will save with DC 10 + the antitheurge’s base attack bonus. Failure means that the creature must succeed on a concentration check of the same DC to cast spells and activate spell-like abilities for 24 hours as the antitheurge leaves a bleeding wound in their astral self.

This ability replaces the bonus feat normally gained at 16th level.
